programme.title: Europe sauvage: Épaves du passé
programme.desc: Porc-épic et blaireau, le plus gros rongeur et le plus gros mustélidé présent en Italie. On découvre aussi le chamois des Abruzzes en suivant la vie d'un chiot qui devient adulte.

programme.title: Europe sauvage: Concert de printemps
programme.desc: Dans les vallées de Comacchio, au printemps, nous assistons au magnifique spectacle qui régule la reproduction des oiseaux. Si, par contre, on creuse dans le sable, tout s'apaise et on découvre un monde miniature silencieux, inattendu et fascinant.

programme.title: Europe sauvage: Dans le royaume de Sardaigne
programme.desc: Lorsque tous les autres oiseaux se préparent à la migration, le faucon de la reine commence à nicher. Pourquoi ? Dans les steppes de Sardaigne, nous observons l’extraordinaire danse nuptiale des mâles de la poule des prés, une espèce menacée d’extinction.

programme.title: Europe sauvage: Des indicateurs biologiques
programme.desc: On y observe le Brahmaea européen, un papillon unique au monde découvert dans les années 1960, et un oiseau migrateur qui, bien qu'il vienne de très loin, est aujourd'hui inextricablement lié à notre pays : le chevalier d'Italie.

programme.title: Europe sauvage: L'Ami des Butteri
programme.desc: La Maremme est une terre surprenante. Au fil du temps, elle a réussi à préserver sa nature dure et fascinante. Pour la dominer aujourd'hui restent les invincibles cowboys italiens, et leurs chevaux fiers, résistants et généreux.

programme.title: Europe sauvage: Vivre ensemble
programme.desc: Les guêpes, nous le savons, ont une organisation sociale complexe. Ce à quoi nous ne pensons pas, cependant, c'est qu'elles devraient se méfier des prédateurs. Parmi ceux-ci se trouve le guêpier, un bel oiseau au plumage coloré.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: À la recherche du léopard
programme.desc: À Naankuse, une femelle léopard a été repérée dans les montagnes, mais, pris au piège, l'animal doit vite être déplacé.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Un déménagement périlleux
programme.desc: Trois lions adultes de Nankusee sont en danger car des braconniers les ont repérés et pourraient les empoisonner ; il faut donc déplacer ces fauves, un exercice dangereux.

programme.title: L'Égypte antique au-delà des pyramides: Les Momies et les cryptes, 2e Partie
programme.desc: L’Égypte antique au-delà des pyramides ressuscitent l'histoire, les mœurs et les religions de cette civilisation mystérieuse, dont les ruines marquent aujourd'hui encore les paysages de l’Égypte moderne.

programme.title: L'Égypte antique au-delà des pyramides
programme.desc: L’Égypte antique au-delà des pyramides ressuscitent l'histoire, les mœurs et les religions de cette civilisation mystérieuse, dont les ruines marquent aujourd'hui encore les paysages de l’Égypte moderne.

programme.title: Les Celtes de Galice
programme.desc: La civilisation Celte, qui s’est développée depuis l’Âge de bronze jusqu’à la période romaine, est l’une des plus anciennes d’Europe. Des sites mégalithiques se trouvent également en Galice.

programme.title: Le Mystère de la momie tatouée
programme.desc: La Dame de Cao est la première femme dirigeante de l'Histoire précolombienne au Pérou, la découverte de sa tombe en 2006 fut un événement majeur dans la connaissance de la civilisation Moche.

programme.title: Aux Armes!
programme.desc: Paul Shull recherche le meilleur fusil de précision de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Planete En Colere
programme.desc: Pour sa toute première expédition en Sibérie, George constate les effets alarmants de la fonte du pergélisol, rend visite à un chien vieux de 12 000 ans et passe la nuit la plus froide de sa vie dans un camp d'éleveurs de rennes.

programme.title: Planete En Colere
programme.desc: George découvre d'anciennes techniques agricoles, visite une réserve qui offre aux éléphants une nouvelle vie, explore une cité troglodyte abandonnée et pagaie sur une rivière souterraine qui renferme des secrets lors d'une excursion au Laos.

programme.title: Planete En Colere
programme.desc: George se rend à Terre-Neuve, la capitale mondiale des icebergs, au Canada, pour observer de près ces géants flottants, d'en haut, d'en bas et depuis le sommet d'une montagne gelée en mouvement.

programme.title: Planete En Colere
programme.desc: George se rend au Bangladesh, un pays qui se trouve en première ligne du changement climatique et qui risque de disparaître, pendant la mousson afin de voir comment les habitants s'adaptent à un environnement de plus en plus hostile.

programme.title: Planete En Colere
programme.desc: Le plus grand prédateur terrestre du monde étant menacé, George se rend dans le Grand Nord canadien pour voir comment les ours polaires s'adaptent au réchauffement rapide du climat.

programme.title: Horizons
programme.desc: De toutes les îles qui ornent notre planète, les Cyclades sont parmi les plus facilement identifiables : éperons rocheux multicolores, villages perchés éclatant de blancheur, eaux azur, chapelles byzantines, champs d’oliviers et troupeaux de chèvres.

programme.title: Horizons
programme.desc: L’île Maurice : une infinité de plages de sable blanc, des lagons multicolores, une cuisine savoureuse, un climat à la douceur constante, une population à la gentillesse proverbiale, et aussi un atout secret.

programme.title: Horizons
programme.desc: La Provence, c’est une lumière particulière, un patrimoine naturel et architectural dont la beauté a inspiré les plus grands peintres. C’est un monde de saveurs, de couleurs et d’odeurs.

programme.desc: Le principe est simple : une personne en invite une autre afin de lui faire une déclaration devant la France entière. L'invité découvre sur le plateau qui l'a fait venir, et peut décider de lever le rideau qui les sépare et le rejoindre... ou pas !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Tribulations en Chine
programme.desc: Sur la grande muraille de Chine, un vendeur étalage achète les cafards à Oggy. En s'en allant, Oggy se sent rapidement coupable : ce sont ses amis après tout ! Il décide donc de les racheter, mais entre-temps, leur prix a été multiplié par 1000 !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Le Fugitif
programme.desc: Oggy prend Dee-Dee en flagrant délit de vol de nourriture dans son réfrigérateur. Pour échapper à l'emprise du chat, le cafard fait semblant d'être mort. Ses congénères et complices appellent immédiatement la police et Oggy est accusé de meurtre !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Invincible
programme.desc: En chassant les cafards sur le toit, Oggy s'écrase sur le sol. Sa tête est aussi plate qu'une crêpe, mais lorsqu'il se relève, il ne ressent aucune douleur et refuse l'aide de Jack ! Jack est convaincu qu'Oggy est devenu un super-héros invincible.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy et le Sourire Magique
programme.desc: Oggy achète un sourire en carton dans un magasin de farces et attrapes. Lorsqu'il met le sourire en carton sur son visage, il se transforme immédiatement en un athlète musclé et super confiant !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Coup de jeune
programme.desc: Une sorcière vole dans le ciel sur son balai lorsque son chapeau s'envole et disparaît dans les nuages. Elle fait demi-tour et se lance à sa poursuite. Le chapeau atterrit dans la cour d'Oggy !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Etno sort de son labo avec une nouvelle invention : la machine à remonter le temps !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Découragé par les vicissitudes de la vie urbaine : bruit, pollution, locataires, etc. Etno créé un ballon qui emporte la maison au vert !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Un matin, rien n’est plus comme avant dans la maison à louer : celle-ci est remplie de barreaux, de grands murs qui l’encerclent…

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Enfin, les monstres s’accommodent du genre humain, ou d’un genre petit et presque humain ! En effet, une foule d’individus habite le jardin sans que cela, pour une fois, n’inquiète nos monstres…

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Jour de fête à la maison ! Pour l’anniversaire de Stereo, les monstres lui ont préparé une surprise : un amuseur professionnel, rien que pour lui !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Depuis son labo, Etno envoie un énième message de détresse en direction de leur planète natale. Bingo ! Un peu plus tard, une soucoupe volante atterrit dans le jardin.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Ce n’est pas sans une certaine excitation que nos monstres voient s’installer un éminent spécialiste de la recherche spatiale en mission dans la maison.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Toujours en train de traîner dans la cuisine, Gorgious asticote le caméléon de Candy et ses autres protégés lorsque, soudain, il tombe par mégarde dans le téléporteur bimoléculaire à protons d’Etno.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Frappé par un météore surgie de nulle part, un bus intergalactique s’écrase sur la Terre. Cinq monstres étranges, Etno, Gorgious, Bud, Candy et Stereo, émergent du véhicule.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Problème : le Grélon est le meilleur ami de Ballotin et Ballotin est le petit-fils du Grand Bouffon.

programme.title: Allociné

programme.title: Bubulle Guppies
programme.desc: Après maintes aventures, les Guppies arrivent enfin à Bubulle-ville pour assister au concert de Stylie. Cepandant, cette dernière tarde à se présenter sur scène. Molly décide d'aller la voir.

programme.title: Bubulle Guppies
programme.desc: Molly et Phil rencontrent Skip, qui emménage dans le quartier. Les Bubulle Guppies vont donc parler de ce que c'est que d'avoir un chez-soi, des différentes pièces et objets qu'on peut y trouver.

programme.title: Dora and Friends: Au Coeur de la Ville
programme.desc: Pablo trouve une bague - une bague très ancienne ayant appartenu à une princesse de l'Antiquité, avant d'être dérobée par un méchant sorcier. Il la passe à son doigt et rapetisse, car la bague était protégée par un enchantement.

programme.title: Dora and Friends: Au Coeur de la Ville
programme.desc: Dora et ses amies organisent un bal caritatif au Café pour financer la nouvelle école de danse. Pablo refuse de participer sous prétexte qu'il déteste danser.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: La vigne arc-en-ciel du Pays des Contes de fées se dessèche, et sa magie va bientôt se tarir. Aide Dora et Babouche à la sauver en allant puiser de l'eau magique au centre du lac qui scintille.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: La vigne arc-en-ciel du Pays des Contes de fées se dessèche, et sa magie va bientôt se tarir. Aide Dora et Babouche à la sauver en allant puiser de l'eau magique au centre du lac qui scintille.

programme.title: Go Diego !
programme.desc: Bébé dauphin d'eau douce est coincé dans une flaque après une violente pluie ! Il doit rentrer chez lui rapidement car aujourd'hui il deviendra rose comme un grand dauphin d'eau douce ! Diego va tout faire pour l'aider !

programme.title: Blaze et les Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze et ses amis Monster Machines font des sauts sur un terrain boueux et terminent tous plein de gadoue. C'est l'occasion d'aller tester la Station de Lavage. Malheureusement pour eux, Crusher la casse avant qu'ils puissent l'utiliser.

programme.title: Blaze et les Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ et Starla rencontrent un troupeau de Camion-vaches perdues et tremblantes de froid. Starla propose de les recueillir dans sa ferme à condition d’entreprendre le voyage. Blaze et AJ acceptent.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, Grandma emmène Dora et Babouche au parc d'attraction. Elle veut refaire des montagnes russes, comme quand elle était petite. Mais dans cette forêt, toutes les attractions sont endormies.

programme.title: Dora l'exploratrice
programme.desc: Dora raconte à Lucky, le chaton de Grandma, l'histoire des trois p'tits chats qui adoraient leurs moufles en laine et avaient composé une chanson pour leur maman. Mais un gros coup de vent les emporte !

programme.title: Bubulle Guppies
programme.desc: La niche de Toutou mimi est accidentellement détruite. Tous les habitants du quartier vont se réunir pour lui en construire une nouvelle.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'herbe-barjot
programme.desc: Mikey fait l'idiot dans le labo de Donnie, qui travaille sur un nouveau sérum anti-parasite destiné à Karaï. À force de jouer, il fait tomber des flacons d'une étagère au contenu dangereux et renverse le sérum sur Donnie, mais pas seulement.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Piège puissance quatre
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Un dinosaure dans les égouts !
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (2/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au-delà des frontières de l'espace
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les lunes de Thalos 3
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le monde selon Wyrm
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le chasseur de primes
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'énigme des Anciens Eons
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.

programme.title: iCarly: Insupportable!
programme.desc: La relation entre Sam et Freddie commence à peser sur tout le monde ! Gibby devient le souffre-douleur attitré de Sam, Carly se fait évincer de la caméra, et aussi des sorties avec ses amies.

programme.title: iCarly: Je t'aime
programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: iCarly: L'intello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: iCarly: rencontre la Première Dame des États-Unis
programme.desc: Carly se réjouit de revoir son père qui rentre fêter son anniversaire avec elle et Spencer. Malheureusement, la jeune fille déchante très vite quand elle apprend que son père ne pourra finalement pas rentrer.

programme.title: iCarly: Nora, à la folie Pt1
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: iCarly: Nora, à la folie Pt2
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: iCarly: Grosses galères et gâteaux gras
programme.desc: Sam n'a pas fait de bêtise depuis 10 jours. En récompense, ses amis lui offrent une visite guidée d'une fabrique de gâteaux gras canadiens, ses pâtisseries préférées.

programme.title: iCarly: Plein les yeux
programme.desc: Freddie est frustré de n'être qu'un technicien. Il rêve de participer à l'aspect artistique de l'émission. Carly devant s'absenter pour le week-end, Sam accepte à contrecoeur de le laisser présenter iCarly avec elle.

programme.title: iCarly: Christopher Cane présente
programme.desc: Christopher Cane (l'acteur anglais qui joue le rôle de Rex dans Victorious) reçoit l'équipe d'iCarly dans son émission.

programme.title: iCarly: L'épidémie One Direction
programme.desc: Carly attrape une maladie contagieuse et contamine un membre des One Direction accidentellement.

programme.title: iCarly: Le restaurant
programme.desc: Avec l'aide de Sam, Gibby ouvre un restaurant secret dans le sous-sol de l'école.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Frank Sinatra, Laurence Harvey, Janet Leigh, and Angela Lansbury headline an all-star cast in this daring thriller rife with political intrigue, mental manipulation, and a diabolical plot that may lead to the highest levels of the government.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster stars in the true story of killer Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz, and who educated himself, becoming a world renowned authority on birds. Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas and Karl Malden co-star.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds (2009)
programme.desc: An American officer is in charge of an all-Jewish squad known as The Basterds and is tasked with the mission of killing as many Nazi troops as possible.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Diabolic
programme.desc: A woman must return to the fundamentalist compound where she was raised after the vengeful spirit of a cursed witch haunts her.

programme.title: We Summon the Darkness
programme.desc: A post-concert party at a remote country mansion turns into a grisly satanic slaughter scene in this dark-humored horror-thriller starring Alexandra Daddario and Johnny Knoxville.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Black Nativity
programme.desc: Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

programme.title: Bad Santa
programme.desc: Arguably the most outrageous Christmas tale ever told, Billy Bob Thornton is a thieving Santa who doesn't care if you've been naughty or nice. Hot on his trail are a security guard, a sexy bartender, and the one kid who's convinced he's the real deal.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Stoke (Billy Bob Thornton) returns as "Santa," this time in an effort to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. It's a hysterical sequel just outrageous enough to outdo the original.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Think Like a Man
programme.desc: Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

programme.title: Think Like a Man Too
programme.desc: All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but plans for a romantic weekend go awry when their various misadventures get them into some compromising situations that threaten to derail the big event.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Allied
programme.desc: When Intelligence Officer Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) learns his wife (Academy Award winner Marion Cotillard) may be conspiring with the enemy, he has only 72 hours to prove her innocence and save his family before he must do the unthinkable.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner portrays the leader of a U.S. bomb-defusing squad in Iraq in this fierce tale of war. The film won 6 Oscars, including the 2009 Best Picture and Best Director (Kathryn Bigelow).

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: El Dorado
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum plays to perfection an alcoholic but gutsy sheriff who relentlessly battles the dark side of the wild West, ruthless cattle barons and crooked “businessmen.”

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: Gluttony, greed, sloth, envy, wrath, pride, lust—everyone has a sin. Detectives William Somerset and David Mills live among these sins every day. But nothing can prepare them for the killings they're about to experience.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: In this edge-of-your-seat supernatural thriller featuring Hollywood's hottest stars, a study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula III: Legacy
programme.desc: The third film in Wes Craven Presents Dracula 2000 series concludes with the dreaded Dracula leading vampire hunters Father and Luke back to Eastern Europe and a country plagued by civil war.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Poltergeist
programme.desc: At first, the spirits that invade the Freelings' home seem like playful children. But then they turn angry. And when 10-year-old Carol Anne is pulled from this world into another, Steve and Diane Freeling turn to an exorcist.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Ghost Town (2008)
programme.desc: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: A diamond heist gone haywire launches gangsters, bookies, and a dog on a rollicking ride through the rugged world of bare-knuckle boxing in search of the missing stone—a critically acclaimed comedy from Guy Ritchie.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: A jewel thief's nephew is sent along on a heist to ensure a longtime partner in crime stays honest about the division of the loot.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: When Su-young stepped out of prison after serving two years to cover up corruption by her fellow cops, she expected the life she was promised as payment. However, she soon realizes that the reward was a lie, and she is not going to let it go.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: After a terror incident occurs mid-flight, a passenger jet declares an emergency.

programme.title: Beasts Clawing at Straws
programme.desc: A bag stuffed full of cash sends a group of hard-luck lowlifes on a desperate chase.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Paul Schrader's gritty screenplay depicts the ever-deepening alienation of Vietnam Veteran Travis Bickle (Robert De Niro in a tour de force performance). This psychotic cab driver obsessively cruises the mean streets of Manhattan.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threaten to kill the hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: Godzilla (1998)
programme.desc: When the enormous monster descends upon New York, it's up to the Army and an odd team of investigators to unravel the mystery behind the incredible creature before it's too late.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants 2
programme.desc: With unraveled embroidery and fraying hems, the pants are back for another glorious summer that four now college-aged friends will never forget.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality 2: Armed and Fabulous
programme.desc: As a result of her heroics in Miss Congeniality, FBI agent Gracie Hart now works the talk show circuit to promote her book. When her pageant friends Cheryl and Stan are kidnapped in Las Vegas, Gracie jumps back into action to save them.

programme.title: Crank
programme.desc: An assassin learns his rival has injected him with a poison that will kill him if his heart rate drops.

programme.title: Crank: High Voltage
programme.desc: Powered by an artificial heart, Chev Chelios (Jason Statham) embarks on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to find the thief who stole his own, nearly indestructible, one.

programme.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
programme.desc: The world's top protection agent gets a new client: a hitman who came in from the cold. After being on the opposite ends of a bullet for years, they must team up and have only 24 hours to get to The Hague to bring down a murderous dictator.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Antwone Fisher
programme.desc: A troubled sailor who embarks on a remarkable journey to confront his past.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster stars in the true story of killer Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz, and who educated himself, becoming a world renowned authority on birds. Thelma Ritter, Telly Savalas and Karl Malden co-star.

programme.title: Frank Capra's A Hole In The Head
programme.desc: Frank Capra catches lightning in bottle again when he teams with Frank Sinatra and Eleanor Parker in this heartwarming comedy about the problems of a footloose widower, his 12-year-old son, a bongo-playing showgirl and a matchmaking sister-in-law.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Grindhouse: Planet Terror/Death Proof
programme.desc: In this Robert Rodriguez/Quentin Tarantino tribute to ’70s exploitation films, a go-go dancer kills zombies in Planet Terror, and a stuntman stalks and kills women in Death Proof.

programme.title: We Summon the Darkness
programme.desc: A post-concert party at a remote country mansion turns into a grisly satanic slaughter scene in this dark-humored horror-thriller starring Alexandra Daddario and Johnny Knoxville.

programme.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
programme.desc: A coven of vampires hunts on dating apps, meeting vampire hunters and scheduling dates. The nights that unfold are action-packed, modern-horror madness.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Black Nativity
programme.desc: Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Code of Silence
programme.desc: When a stakeout marred by mob interference results in the death of an innocent bystander and a police cover-up, a Chicago detective is forced to adhere to his own personal code of ethics in an effort to rid the Windy City of its Warring crime factions.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A.
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov catches America unprepared and makes it a war zone from sea to shining sea. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Who's Harry Crumb?
programme.desc: John Candy is bigger, better, and more bumbling than ever as a soft-headed private eye determined to crack a kidnapping case.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: This Is 40
programme.desc: From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: Shutter Island

programme.title: Trapeze
programme.desc: Aerialist Burt Lancaster--who retired after suffering an injury--agrees to train aspiring trapeze artist Tony Curtis. But when both men fall in love with the beautiful and ambitious Gina Lollobrigida, the triangle threaten the dreams of them all.

programme.title: Houdini
programme.desc: Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

programme.title: Greatest Show On Earth
programme.desc: Charlton Heston stars as Brad Braden, the circus manager who lives and breathes to keep the show rolling. With the Big Top about to hit rock bottom, Braden hires The Great Sebastian, a daring trapeze legend, to revitalize the circus.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to take revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Black Nativity
programme.desc: Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

programme.title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
programme.desc: A driven, idealistic defense attorney's life is suddenly disrupted when he is recruited to join a firm led by ambitious lawyer George Pierce and begins a friendship with a young champion for equal rights.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage, and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin, and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: Licorice Pizza
programme.desc: Licorice Pizza' is the story of Alana Kane and Gary Valentine growing up, running around and falling in love in the San Fernando Valley, 1973. Written and Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, the film tracks the treacherous navigation of first love.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: A romantically challenged TV producer's search for Mr. Perfect has left her hopelessly single. She's in for a rude awakening when her boss teams her with Mike Chadway, a hardcore TV personality who promises to spill the ugly truth about romance.

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: Set in New York on New Year's Eve, this romantic comedy celebrates love, hope, forgiveness, second chances, and fresh starts through the intertwining stories of couples and singles, told amid the pulse and promise of the most dazzling night of the year.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: Child 44
programme.desc: Exiled secret police officer Leo Demidov (Tom Hardy) discovers a serial killer and suspects his superiors of covering it up. It is up to Leo to stop the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: The Ides of March
programme.desc: Ambition seduces, and power corrupts in a nerve-wracking thriller from Academy Award-nominated director George Clooney (Good Night, and Good Luck). Rating: R

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Aftersun
programme.desc: Years after their last vacation, Sophie reflects on the rare time spent with her loving, idealistic father and tries to reconcile the father she knew with the man she didn't.

programme.title: C'mon C'mon
programme.desc: Johnny and his young nephew forge a tenuous but transformational relationship when they are unexpectedly thrown together in this delicate and deeply moving story about the connections between adults and children, the past and the future.

programme.title: Red Rocket
programme.desc: Mikey Saber (a magnetic Simon Rex) — a charismatic con man and washed-up porn star — plots his return to the big time from small-town Texas in this wild, fiercely funny portrait of an American hustler and a hometown that barely tolerates him.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: Day of the Outlaw
programme.desc: Two rival cattlemen forget their differences to fight six outlaws who take over the isolated Western town.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Carrie (2002)
programme.desc: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror. Carrie White has been cursed with the power of telekinesis and when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivable humiliation, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: A mobster's wife hates her lifestyle, but gets a chance to change it when her husband is killed--if the Long Island mob and the FBI let her.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Staying Alive takes Saturday Night Fever’s Tony Manero out of Brooklyn to Broadway. As a wannabe dancer struggling to make it on the stage, John Travolta is at his sexy, sizzling best.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Ghost Town (2008)
programme.desc: A spirited romantic comedy, Ghost Town is the story of Bertram Pincus, a cranky Manhattan dentist who develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people.

programme.title: Last Holiday
programme.desc: Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: When Su-young stepped out of prison after serving two years to cover up corruption by her fellow cops, she expected the life she was promised as payment. However, she soon realizes that the reward was a lie, and she is not going to let it go.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights, and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose offhand arrogance triggers a tragedy that ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: Steve Martin turns in a heartwarming and hilarious performance.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: King Kong (1976)
programme.desc: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

programme.title: Thunderbolt and Lightfoot
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood and Jeff Bridges lead a strong supporting cast in this offbeat crime caper about a colorful group of bank robbers determined to break into the fortress-like Montana Armored Depository.

programme.title: The End
programme.desc: When Sonny (Burt Reynolds) is diagnosed with a fatal disease, he swallows a bottle of pills to end it all! Instead, he ends up in a loony bin beside the demented Marlon (Dom DeLuise) who is eager to help Sonny succeed...one madcap attempt at a time!

programme.title: Robocop
programme.desc: Detroit in the near future. A cop who dies in the line of duty is transformed into a crime-fighting cyborg by the corporation which now runs the police department. The only hitch: this "perfect" cop still seeks revenge on the creeps who mutilated him.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants

programme.desc: Quando l'ex ragazzo di Phoebe arriva in città, porta con sé dei guai sotto forma di un'urna egiziana rubata contenente una maledizione mortale. Intanto, Prue affronta i suoi problemi e cerca di salvare la casa d'aste dalla bancarotta.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Quando Piper viene aggredita da una bestia feroce, Andy si apposta con un agente dell'FBI che dà la caccia alla creatura. Intanto, Prue assume Phoebe alla casa d'aste.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Il Demone della Paura emerge dopo 1300 anni e mira a uccidere 13 streghe nubili entro mezzanotte, incluse le Streghe del Trio. Le sorelle devono imparare a vincere le loro paure per sconfiggerlo.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Prue aiuta un giovane stregone che è stato rapito ed è ancora convinta di volere dei figli. Intanto, Phoebe scopre che Leo è un angelo custode delle streghe buone, il che porta Leo a lasciare Piper.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: La paura di Phoebe dell'Uomo nero diverte Prue e Piper, finché un terremoto libera un demone ombra. Phoebe, controllata dall'Uomo nero, tenta di uccidere Prue e Piper, che devono trovare un modo di salvare Phoebe e liberarsi dell'Uomo nero.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney e Nigel si riuniscono con Stewie Harper, alla ricerca del Calice della Verità, in Francia.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Sydney e Nigel si dirigono a Parigi, in Francia, per cercare un medaglione rubato.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Kuba, Africa 100 d.C.: I seguaci di Woote maledicono l'idolo della prosperità, per proteggerlo.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: India, 500 dC: Un prezioso pugnale è stato usato per sacrificare vite umane in onore della dea Kali.

programme.title: Relic Hunter
programme.desc: Nigel e i suoi colleghi sono catturati da guerriglieri locali.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Un famoso chirurgo viene chiamato a operare Costa, ma mostra segni sospetti. Nina indaga mentre Proust torna di nascosto in ospedale. Julien chiede a Nina di partire con lui e Kevin affronta una paziente bipolare.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Durante la convalescenza di Costa un paziente sospetto Ebola costringe Nina e Bergman all’isolamento. Léo segue una hostess dalla doppia vita sentimentale.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Dopo la nomina di Proust a capo reparto, Nina affronta la morte del padre. Si dedica a una donna incinta che rifiuta cure salvavita e incontra Smireni, specialista del dolore. Intanto Lily annuncia di voler partire per il Canada.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Nina soffre di dolori alla schiena mentre Lily è pronta a partire. Un’interna rischia il visto per una malattia nascosta. Kevin entra in competizione con una collega esperta. Smireni ricorda che il dolore non è solo fisico.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Con Lily lontana, Nina e Costa sono in crisi. Un’amica medico nasconde una grave malattia. Proust sfida un paziente ossessionato dal cuore “monitorato” da un chip. Costa decide di partire per la Grecia.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: In seguito al trasferimento di Giulia Corsi, il suo vice Roberto Ardenzi diventa il commissario del X Tuscolano. Durante la cerimonia di insediamento una banda di rapinatori fa irruzione nella villa di un ricco notaio disattivando il sistema d'allarme.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: In seguito ad un'azione condotta col neocommissario Roberto, Mauro viene preso in ostaggio dai due fratelli pugliesi capeggiati dal napoletano Gabriele, responsabili di sanguinose rapine. Alessandro Berti della Scientifica si offre come esca.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: L'intuito del neocommissario Roberto non sbaglia: dietro la morte apparentemente casuale della modella Eva Paulin si nasconde qualcosa di piu'. La giovane, con la complicita' del fratello Milo, rubava ai suoi ricchi clienti oggetti preziosi.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Francesca, trovata da suo marito in una pozza di sangue nella loro casa, deve essere operata d'urgenza. Sia lei che il bimbo rischiano di perdere la vita. Intanto Luca, Anna e Irene, indagano su uno strano incidente che coinvolge un loro collega.

programme.title: Distretto di Polizia
programme.desc: Il neonato Francesco, figlio di Roberto e Francesca, viene salvato dopo una lunga operazione. E' subito festeggiato dai fratellini e dagli agenti del X Tuscolano. Il neocommissario capisce che deve affrontare un personaggio del passato, Cesare Carrano.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Philippe Cazenave, primario di ginecologia all’ospedale La Timone di Marsiglia, crolla in Pronto Soccorso durante il giro mattutino. Le tracce di sangue sui vestiti indicano un omicidio.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: La famiglia Redon è scomparsa da quattro giorni, lasciando la casa a soqquadro. Boris e Constance scavano nella vita di una famiglia all’apparenza normale, guidata da un padre autoritario e corrotto.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: All’alba viene ritrovato il corpo senza vita di Lucie, 18 anni, vicino a un prestigioso collegio. Boris e Constance ricostruiscono la notte precedente, svelando la personalità enigmatica della giovane.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Ricostruendo una scena del crimine, Boris e Constance scoprono che Rémi Bruder, reo confesso, mente per proteggere il vero assassino. Dice di aver ucciso Céline per amore, ma la verità è un’altra.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Durante un’immersione al largo delle scogliere di Gresse, una giovane donna scompare nelle profondità del mare. Quella che sembrava una lezione subacquea si trasforma in un mistero inquietante.

programme.desc: I turni di Cynthia nel quartiere la portano ad assistere il diabetico John Lacey, un deplorevole bulletto che umilia costantemente la moglie.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 2, Episodio 10
programme.desc: Chummy e Peter si preparano a diventare genitori. Fred riceve una visita dalla figlia Dolly, incinta. Nel frattempo, Suor Bernadette affronta i suoi difficili punti di svolta.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Special Christmas 2013: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Viene scoperta una bomba inesplosa. Questo fatto getta lo scompiglio tra le suore, le levatrici e tutti gli abitanti di Poplar proprio a pochi giorni dal Natale.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Special Christmas 2013: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Jenny Lee si ritrova risucchiata nella vita della giovane coppia formata da Yvonne e Alan Bridges, in attesa del primo figlio.

programme.title: L'amore e la vita - Call the Midwife: Serie 3, Episodio 3
programme.desc: Suor Julienne riceve una telefonata dalla Prigione Holloway dove l'Esercito della Salvezza, che solitamente fornisce assistenza alle detenute, è stato decimato dall'influenza.

programme.title: I Coltelli del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Un misterioso guerriero vichingo lanciatore di coltelli protegge una giovane contadina e suo figlio dalle grinfie di un malvagio reggente deciso a rivendicare per sé il titolo di re e la donna.

programme.title: L'arciere nero
programme.desc: Accusato ingiustamente dell’omicidio del padre, il giovane Corrado di Sant’Elia è costretto alla fuga e diventa un fuorilegge. Deciso a scoprire i veri responsabili, si trova coinvolto nelle trame di due cugini intenzionati a impadronirsi del potere.

programme.title: Ercole contro Roma
programme.desc: Il prefetto Filippo Afro uccide l’imperatore Gordiano e sale sul trono di Roma, ma la figlia di Gordiano, Ulpia, chiama in aiuto Ercole. Inizia così lo scontro con l’esercito dell’imperatore.

programme.title: Golia e il cavaliere mascherato
programme.desc: Tra castelli, duelli e congiure, Golia affronta nemici mascherati per difendere il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Andromeda: Attraversato dalle stelle
programme.desc: L'avatar di Rommie s’innamora di quello che si rivela essere l'avatar di una nave da guerra di nome Gabriel. Gabriel cerca d’infettare Rommie con un virus capace di trasmettere i suoi piani alla nave da guerra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Fa una bella luce
programme.desc: Beka conduce l'Andromeda a Tarn-Vedra, ma rimanere a lungo nello slipstream ha degli effetti collaterali. Beka inizia a usare Flash per combatterli e ne diventa presto dipendente.

programme.title: Andromeda: È ora di fare vista finalmente
programme.desc: Una vecchia memoria dell'Andromeda viene accidentalmente attivata, lanciando la nave in missione. Dylan e l'equipaggio non sanno come annullare il comando.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il vortice che si allarga
programme.desc: Dylan e Rommie devono salvare Tyr, Harper e Rev dal mondo dei Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Strategie di uscita
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev e Tyr fanno un brusco atterraggio dopo essere scappati da una banda di Nietzscheani, ma dovranno presto affrontare una nuova minaccia: Rev ha fame.

programme.title: Andromeda: Come incastrare un bugiardo
programme.desc: L'equipaggio deve rubare un gioiello che è al centro di una faida tra un proprietario di Drift e il Than. Beka s’innamora di un capo della sicurezza con un passato da ladro.

programme.title: Un'estate a Firenze
programme.desc: L'incontro tra un giocatore di football americano e una ragazza in visita alla cugina. Un amore che nasce sullo sfondo di Firenze.

programme.title: Amore a Cedar Creek
programme.desc: Allison Sawyer è una giornalista che scrive del suo autore preferito che ha basato tutti i suoi romanzi sul bellissimo Clybourne Ranch. Lì incontra Hank che gestisce il posto da anni. Mentre Allison scrive, diventa anche molto più vicina a Hank...

programme.title: L'anello perfetto
programme.desc: Proprietaria di una gioielleria, Kate disegna anelli di fidanzamento e fedi nuziali. Quando, un giorno, rivede il suo primo amore Jaimie, questi le offre di lavorare come stilista di gioielli in una grande casa di oreficeria.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Molti volti familiari dal grande successo "Grease" ritornano al campus e i nuovi sono altrettanto memorabili in questo allegro tributo alle gonne al ginocchio, i corteggiamenti e gli amori giovanili.

programme.title: Sansone
programme.desc: Sansone è un alano abbastanza furbo da tenere sotto scacco il suo padrone e combinare montagne di guai, sempre perdonati dalla sua famiglia umana.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: Il premio* Oscar(r) Cuba Gooding Jr. interpreta Darrin Hill, uno sfortunato manager di New York che torna nella sua città natale per reclamare l'eredità lasciatagli dalla zia. Ma prima di averla, dovrà esaudire l'ultimo desiderio della zia.

programme.title: Speriamo che sia femmina
programme.desc: In un casale della campagna toscana, un gruppo di donne vive in equilibrio. Elena guida la fattoria, mentre Fosca, cuore pratico della casa, si prende cura delle giovani Martina e Immacolata. Tra assenze, egoismi e affetti, emergono tensioni profonde.

programme.title: James Tont Operazione D.U.E.
programme.desc: Un pericoloso gruppo criminale vuole distruggere la basilica di San Pietro seguendo un piano chiamato Operazione DUE, Distruzione Urbe Eterna. L'unico che può fermarli è l'agente segreto James Tont. Con il mitico Lando Buzzanca.

programme.title: Antonio e Placido - Attenti ragazzi, chi rompe... paga!
programme.desc: Una nave ferma al porto di Istanbul dovrebbe imbarcare verdure, ma un uomo senza scrupoli vorrebbe nascondere delle armi al di sotto di esse. Il capitano della nave rifiuta l'offerta del malfattore.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Les va giù
programme.desc: La rissa non è fuori dall'ordinario all'American Jewelry e al prestito, ma quando i clienti buttano giù nel parcheggio prima ancora che le porte si aprano, Les sa che è un brutto segno.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Pilota 1
programme.desc: Dal momento in cui i creditori hanno stretto le cinghie del portafogli e bloccato i prestiti, i residenti di Detroit sanno che possono sempre contare su American Jewelry and Loan, "la banca del lavoratore".

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Pilota 2
programme.desc: Incontrate la famiglia Gold. Come proprietari del più grande banco dei pegni di Detroit, hanno comprato e venduto cose che non potete neanche immaginare.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Contanti pericolosi
programme.desc: Un cliente arrabbiato minaccia Les e mette in allerta l'intero negozio. Nel mezzo del caos, Ashley e Seth fanno una scommessa amichevole sul riuscire a vendere un palo da lap dance.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Alcolici e pistole
programme.desc: I Gold discutono sulla necessità di procurare un arma a tutti all'interno del negozio, dopo che un cliente minaccia Les.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Alligatore a prova di proiettile
programme.desc: Quando un alligatore si ribella al proprietario, lui cerca di venderlo ai Golds. Ashley e Seth non vogliono avere a che fare con il rettile.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Bersaglio mobile
programme.desc: Sale la tensione quando un cliente va su tutte le furie per un fraintendimento riguardo una catena d'oro. Ashley si arrabbia quando un cliente cerca di vendere un relitto che è maledetto.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Trouble Inside
programme.desc: Un dipendente diventa violento e quasi divide la famiglia. Poi, Ashley quasi esplode quando un cliente aggressivo prova a vendere 50 paia di mutande non molto pulite.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Padre contro figlio
programme.desc: Seth si scontra con suo padre quando questi gli propone di investire un'ingente somma di denaro per il parcheggio, creando una situazione pericolosa.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: La grande scommessa di Les
programme.desc: Les va su tutte le furie quando una guardia di sicurezza zittisce un cliente.

programme.title: Il Banco dei Pugni: Oro al mirino
programme.desc: Les porta Ashley e Seth all festa di chiusura del negozio di pegni che suo nonno aveva apart a Detroit, dove Les racconta un'inquietante storia di una rapina e sparatoria cui ha assistito.

programme.title: Uno chef per Natale
programme.desc: Quando l'ambiziosa corrispondente gastronomica, CARLY HAYES, ha la possibilità di realizzare un suo show, nulla va come previsto.

programme.title: Natale sotto la neve
programme.desc: Kaley, una giovane ragazza alla pari, si ritrova nell'impossibilità di tornare a casa per le vacanze quando una tempesta di neve fa deragliare i suoi piani.

programme.title: Come Innamorarsi a Natale
programme.desc: Nora Winters, the fiercely talented writer-turned-CEO of her own lifestyle brand, PRISM, finds herself in a tight spot when the company’s future hangs in the balance.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Sharknado - Era Ora!
programme.desc: L'ultimo capitolo della fantastica saga Sharknado. Fin sblocca il potere del viaggio nel tempo degli Sharknado per salvare il mondo e resuscitare la sua famiglia. Nella sua ricerca combatterà nazisti, dinosauri, cavalieri e farà un giro sull'arca di Noè.

programme.title: Hornet
programme.desc: Quando una razza aliena invade e inizia a fare il lavaggio del cervello agli umani per compiere atti di distruzione, il resto dell'umanità deve affidarsi a un robot gigante, non testato, per salvare la Terra.

programme.title: Robots overlords
programme.desc: I robot comandano sulla Terra e costringono gli umani a restare chiusi in casa con un sofisticato congegno, pena la morte. Un gruppo di ragazzi scopre un metodo per superare la segregazione e ingaggia una resistenza.

programme.title: Il Tredicesimo È Sempre Giuda
programme.desc: In un piccolo villaggio confinante col Messico, un gruppo di persone si accinge a festeggiare le nozze di Ned Carter e Mary Bell. In una delle carrozze viene trovato il cadavere della sposa. Tra i tredici invitati, uno di loro è sicuramente il colpevole.

programme.title: Adios Cjamango
programme.desc: Le avventure di Cjamango e Peggy, due giovani sposi proprietari di un ranch che si battono per salvare la propria casa dalle grinfie di una compagnia ferroviaria decisa ad acquistare il loro terreno.

programme.title: Odia il prossimo tuo
programme.desc: Un killer viene assoldato per uccidere Bill Dakota e sua moglie, che posseggono la mappa di un giacimento d'oro. Il fratello di Bill giura vendetta e persuade il mandante del killer a consegnare questi alla giustizia. Anche il mandante finisce male.

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: Quando una meteora si schianta sulla luna e ne sposta l'asse, la gravità terrestre trascina la luna sulla traiettoria del pianeta. Ora, un gruppo di scienziati deve capire come impedire alla luna di colpire la Terra prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare il suo regno dall'avanzata di un esercito di elfi oscuri, la principessa Vanir deve attraversare la foresta infestata di Sidhe con l'aiuto dei fedeli avventurieri Cador e Artemir.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Un ceppo mutante di giganteschi piranha feroci scappa dall'Amazzonia e si fa strada verso la Florida.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Tutti Prima Parte
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus recluta un perspicace psichiatra forense chiamato Will Zimmerman per unirsi a lei nella ricerca di rintracciare, studiare e proteggere le strane e spesso terrificanti creature che popolano segretamente il nostro mondo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Tutti Seconda Parte
programme.desc: e proteggere le La dottoressa Helen Magnus recluta un perspicace psichiatra forense chiamato Will Zimmerman per unirsi a lei nella ricerca di rintracciare, studiare strane e spesso terrificanti creature che popolano segretamente il nostro mondo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Fata Morgana
programme.desc: La dottoressa Magnus, sua figlia Ashley e il dottor Will Zimmerman liberano tre donne da una misteriosa cripta in Scozia, riportandole al Santuario per trovare rifugio. All'insaputa della squadra, e delle donne stesse, loro hanno poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Sanctuary: L'uomo Flessibile
programme.desc: Un'indagine su una serie di bizzarre rapine porta Magnus e Will a una banda criminale di ladri che sembrano essere in grado di intrufolarsi tra le crepe della legge... letteralmente.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Kush
programme.desc: Di ritorno con un anormale catturato in Himalaya, Magnus e Will sono isolati dalla civiltà dopo che il loro aereo precipita in una catena montuosa Mentre aspettano una squadra di soccorso, i sopravvissuti cominciano a essere vittime di attacchi.

programme.title: Sanctuary: I Nubbini
programme.desc: Quando una coppia di anormali carini, pelosi e apparentemente innocui viene portata per uno studio scientifico, la squadra del Santuario inizia a mostrare alcune attrazioni animali nascoste l'una per l'altra.

programme.title: Un Divorzio Pericoloso
programme.desc: Quando l'ex marito di Josie, Michael, le fa un'offerta di lavoro che non può rifiutare, si trova in mezzo ad un brutale divorzio tra Michael e la sua pazza ex moglie Cora.

programme.title: Finché Ex non ci Separi
programme.desc: Ispirato a eventi reali - Proprio quando Kyle e Sophia hanno concluso la loro separazione, Sophia viene accusata di aver aggredito Claire, una donna che è stata con il marito. In realtà, Claire sta incastrando Sophia per tenersi Kyle.

programme.title: Tutti i segreti della mia famiglia
programme.desc: Dopo la morte dei genitori in circostanze misteriose, Emily, la figlia maggiore, per prendersi cura dei suoi fratelli più piccoli, Lexi ed Ethan, accetta un lavoro in una nuova città dove accadono strani eventi.

programme.title: Cheerleader pericolose
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della sorella, Maisy non è convinta della teoria del suo suicidio ed è determinata a scoprire la verità su quanto accaduto.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Gli sviluppi tecnologici potrebbero aiutare a risolvere un caso di omicidio di dodici anni fa.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Scienziati in pensione usano l'equipaggiamento sonar per localizzare le vittime scomparse.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prova Stampata
programme.desc: Quando due donne scomparvero e in seguito furono ritrovate brutalmente assassinate, la polizia si chiese se fossero vittime di un crimine d'odio.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Quando una studentessa universitaria viene accoltellata, il sospetto cade sulla sua coinquilina.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: L'origine della specie

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Lo zoo

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: La peggiore delle ipotesi

programme.title: Mogli assassine
programme.desc: Scopriamo i racconti personali di donne spinte oltre il limite. Una donna al quarto mese di matrimonio accoltella il proprio marito alla schiena quando lui chiede il divorzio.

programme.desc: Jameelah, studentessa di Baltimora, si innamora di James, spacciatore di droga. Neanche la prigione li separa e i due si sposano. Ma la situazione diventa difficile e in un momento di rabbia lei lo accoltella.

programme.title: Mogli assassine
programme.desc: Sarah Saunders decide di voler mettere fine alla propria soffocante relazione. La donna colpisce in testa il fidanzato con un coltello. L'uomo, tuttavia, miracolosamente sopravvive.

programme.title: Mogli assassine

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Quirino cerca di conquistare Gabriella, amante di Alvaro, con la complessità della timidezza.
